This is a Checkpoint, step over it to save
your progress. Press R to reset to the last
Checkpoint.

Welcome to Chip Challonge, a re-creation of the classic tile-based puzzle/action game Chip's Challenge
created by Chuck Sommerville. It is included to show off some of what Grid Game Maker is capable of.

This level is a quick introduction to most of the elements and mechanics.

I wouldn't step on these if I were you.
Maybe those blocks can help.
Stuff can be hidden under blocks.

Even dangerous stuff!
(sorry)

Dirt (green) and gravel (black) are tiles that creatures cannot move over.
You can push blocks over gravel.
If you already know all this you can open the level select from the pause menu
Collect all the chips required for the socket in order to be able to open it
Unlike other colors, green keys can be re-used indefinitely
If you pick up fire boots, you'll be able to safely traverse fire.

Fireballs (purple) are immune to fire,
Gliders (blue) are immune to water.
Fireballs prefer turning right, Gliders prefer turning left.
The trash can gets rid of all your terrain protection items (boots)
scuba gear allows you to swim safely
This is the level goal, but it looks like you can't reach this one.
Cloner Machines create a new copy of the element on top when their button is pressed.
I wonder where this one goes...

Watch out!
Teleporters spit you out in the same direction you entered.
Watch out for creatures!
Traps keep you held in place unless their button is held.
